title: 第23章 步入神国周天星斗第24章 鬼斧神工先秦炼气士仙府内的秘密
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
全国的观众，意见再次出现了分歧。
有人认为太危险，应该立刻撤退。
但更多的人，则被这巨大的谜团深深吸引，渴望着能看到门后的世界。
现场，林薇也在做着同样艰难的抉择。
“林队，医疗队已经下来了。我们……还要继续吗？”
一名队员问道。
林薇看着那道门缝，眼神闪烁不定。
理智告诉她，前方充满了未知的危险，最稳妥的选择是立刻带着伤员撤退，重新评估风险。
但她的直觉，她作为一名顶尖考古学者的本能，却在疯狂地叫嚣着，让她进去。
真相，就在这扇门后。
一个可能会颠覆人类历史的真相。
她深吸一口气，做出了决定。
“把伤员交给医疗队，让他们立刻返回地面。”
“其余的人，检查装备，补充弹药。五分钟后，我们进去！”
“什么？！”
这个决定，让所有队员都大吃一惊。
“林队，三思啊！里面太危险了！”
“是啊队长，我们对里面的情况一无所知，就这么进去，太冒失了！”
队员们纷纷劝阻。
林薇的眼神却异常坚定，她扫视着自己的队员，一字一句地说道：“我们的职责是什么？”

“是探索未知，是发掘真相！”
“现在，真相就在我们眼前。我们是第一批，也可能是唯一一批有机会接触到它的人。如果我们现在退缩了，我们还有什么资格，自称是‘开拓者’？”
“我意已决。愿意跟我进去的，现在就去准备。不愿意的，可以护送伤员一起返回，我不会怪你们。”
她的话，铿锵有力，掷地有声。
队员们互相看了看，眼神中的犹豫和恐惧，渐渐被名为“使命感”的火焰所取代。
他们是军人，是考古队员，更是国家的“开拓者”。
服从命令，一往无前，是刻在他们骨子里的信念。
“我们跟您进去！”
“对！不就是个门吗？十八层地狱我们都敢闯！”
“算我一个！”
没有一个人退缩。
五分钟后，队伍重新集结。
虽然有几人受伤，但整个队伍的士气，却空前高涨。
林薇站在队伍的最前方，她最后看了一眼头盔摄像头，在对全国观众宣告。
“各位，接下来，你们将要看到的，或许会颠覆你们的认知。请记住，无论发生什么，都不要怀疑你们的眼睛。”
说完，她不再犹豫，第一个迈开脚步，走进了那道闪烁着神秘星辉的裂缝之中。
大殿当林薇的脚踏入门后世界的瞬间，她感觉自己穿过了一层薄薄的水幕。
眼前那摇晃的、充满了压迫感的黑暗甬道消失了。
取而代之的，是一片让她永生难忘的景象。
“这……是……”

林薇的声音通过通讯器传出，但后面的话，却因为极致的震撼而卡在了喉咙里。
她身后的队员们，也一个个跟了进来。
content_en:
Audiences across the country are once again divided in their opinions.
Some people think it is too dangerous and should retreat immediately.
But more people are deeply attracted by this huge mystery, eager to see the world behind the door.
At the scene, Lin Wei was also making the same difficult decision.
"Captain Lin, the medical team has come down. Do we... still want to continue?"
one team member asked.
Lin Wei looked at the crack in the door, her eyes flickering.
Reason told her that the front was full of unknown dangers, and the safest choice was to immediately retreat with the wounded and reassess the risks.
But her instincts, her instincts as a top archaeologist, were screaming at her madly to let her in.
The truth is behind this door.
A truth that could overturn human history.
She took a deep breath and made a decision.
"Hand the wounded over to the medical team and have them return to the ground immediately."
"The rest of you, check your equipment and replenish ammunition. We'll go in in five minutes!"
"What?!"
This decision surprised all the team members.
"Captain Lin, think twice! It's too dangerous inside!"
"Yes, Captain, we don't know anything about what's going on inside. It's too rash to just go in like this!"
The team members tried to dissuade him.
Lin Wei's eyes were extremely firm. She glanced at her team members and said word by word: "What is our responsibility?"
"It's about exploring the unknown and discovering the truth!"
"Now, the truth is right in front of us. We are the first and probably the only ones who have the opportunity to come into contact with it. If we shrink back now, what qualifications do we have to call ourselves 'pioneers'?"
"I've made up my mind. Those who are willing to go in with me should prepare now. If not, you can escort the wounded back together. I won't blame you."
Her words were sonorous and powerful.
The team members looked at each other, and the hesitation and fear in their eyes were gradually replaced by the flame called "sense of mission."
They are soldiers, archaeological team members, and "pioneers" of the country.
Obeying orders and moving forward courageously is a belief engraved in their bones.
"We'll follow you in!"
"Yes! Isn't it just a door? We dare to break through the eighteen levels of hell!"
"Count me in!"
No one flinched.
Five minutes later, the team regrouped.
Although several people were injured, the morale of the entire team was unprecedentedly high.
Lin Wei stood at the front of the team. She took one last look at the helmet camera and announced to the national audience.
"Everyone, what you are going to see next may subvert your understanding. Please remember, no matter what happens, don't doubt your eyes."
After saying that, she no longer hesitated, and was the first to step forward, walking into the crack that shone with mysterious stars.
The moment Lin Wei stepped into the world behind the main hall, she felt like she had passed through a thin curtain of water.
The shaky, oppressive dark corridor in front of me disappeared.
Instead, there was a scene that she would never forget.
"This...is..."
Lin Wei's voice came out through the communicator, but the words that followed were stuck in her throat due to the extreme shock.
The team members behind her also followed in one by one.
